title.narrative: Market study and report based on surveys, interviews and focus groups in at least 15 factories

description.narrative: Market study and report based on surveys, interviews and focus groups in at least 15 factoriesActivity 1: Electronic Wage Payments Cambodia

comment.narrative: 1 The market study was completed in 2021. It was conducted by IFC in collaboration with BSR. The study was based on surveys focus groups and interviews that assess the potential market for payroll digitization for garment workers in Cambodia. The research focused on the markets three main stakeholders workers factories and financial service providers as well as other key stakeholders such as unions and local merchants to understand their main challenges and opportunities related to wage digitization. The research sample included 114 garment factories 56 of which are fully or partially digitized. The research team also conducted interviews with 413 workers 82 of whom were female from 68 factories. 2 A public version of the report was finalized in May 2022 and published on Better Work IFC and BSR websites in October 2022. The report includes the main findings and recommendations from the study on how to enhance wage digitization in Cambodia. See more details on these results in the progress reports for November 2020December 2021 and for JanuaryDecember 2022.
